lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A sparse arrangement of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters is visible posterior to the gill region, forming a non-linear grid where primary nodes are spaced at intervals approximately 10-15% of the visible flank width.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal axes of high-intensity blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature persists along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance pixels on the superior edge and a defined shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of smaller, lower-intensity spots that contrast with the larger, more widely spaced blobs on the primary flank.
